analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 32.5로 과매도 구간 진입, 5일 저가 52,110원이 20일 저가 51,065원 대비 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성 초입. ADX 29.5로 뚜렷한 추세는 미약하나, -DI가 +DI보다 우위인 약세 흐름 지속. 52주 저가 37,815원 대비 현재가 52,135원 위치는 6.7% 수준으로 여전히 낮은 편. 단기 반등 가능성 있으나 추세 전환 확신 부족.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI at 32.5 enters oversold territory, and the 5-day low of $52,110 is higher than the 20-day low of $51,065, indicating the start of a Higher Low pattern. ADX at 29.5 suggests a clear trend is weak, with -DI remaining above +DI, continuing a bearish flow. The current price of $52,135 is still low at 6.7% of the 52-week low of $37,815. Short-term rebound potential exists, but conviction for a trend reversal is lacking.

[모멘텀 지표]

· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (하단 $49,174) + 하단 접근 구간, 밴드폭 49.72%로 넓음
[지지·저항 구조]

· 스윙 저항선 ($80,380) + 돌파 시 중기 추세 전환 기대
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low 형성 중) + 회복 신호 가능성
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.91배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 보통 수준
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 단기 반등 시도 확인 후 관망 조건 명시
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($52,135) vs SMA5/20/50 ($58,128/$65,444/$87,038): below short/mid-term trends, confirming weak position.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($106,964/$112,877): very weak long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (6.7%) + current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.2→32.5) + entering oversold territory + continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (previous→current) + improving diagnosis + trend reversal signal still weak.
· Bollinger Band current price position (lower band $49,174) + approaching lower band, band width wide at 49.72%.
[Support & Resistance]
· Swing support ($51,065) + based on 20-day low, near current price.
· Swing resistance ($80,380) + breakthrough could signal mid-term trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (forming Higher Low) + potential for recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.91x) + moderate confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + observe after short-term rebound attempt confirmation.
